definitions.explanation: The state of being drunk, or the effect of alcohol as it takes hold and wears off.
Nausea from riding in a vehicle; mostly in compounds such as {乗|の}り{物|もの}{酔|よ}い and {酔|よ}い{止|ど}め.

examples.japanese: {酔|よ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{回|まわ}って→回る：01150_mawaru⟧きた。
examples.english: The alcohol is starting to kick in.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んで→飲む：00322_nomu⟧{酔|よ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|さ}ました→覚ます：02057_samasu⟧。
examples.english: I drank cold water to sober up.

examples.japanese: {昨夜|ゆうべ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{酔|よ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{残|のこ}っていて→残る：01187_nokoru⟧、⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧。
examples.english: Last night's drinking is still with me, and my head has felt heavy since morning.

examples.japanese: {酔|よ}い{止|ど}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れ→揺れ：16137_yure⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{酔|よ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどく→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The swaying of the bus made my motion sickness worse.

examples.japanese: ⟦{乗|の}り{物|もの}→乗り物：01694_norimono⟧{酔|よ}いしやすい⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{向|む}いて→向く：02304_muku⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: People prone to motion sickness should sit facing forward.

notes:
The noun of ⟦{酔|よ}う→酔う：14437_you⟧ (to get drunk; to get motion sick).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {酔|よ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧: the alcohol takes effect
- {酔|よ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{覚|さ}める→覚める：02058_sameru⟧ / {酔|よ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|さ}ます→覚ます：02057_samasu⟧: to sober up / to sober (oneself) up
- {酔|よ}い{止|ど}め: motion sickness medicine
- ⟦{二日酔|ふつかよ}い→二日酔い：08331_futsukayoi⟧: hangover
- ⟦{船酔|ふなよ}い→船酔い：30619_funayoi⟧ / ⟦{車酔|くるまよ}い→車酔い：14733_kurumayoi⟧ / ⟦{乗|の}り{物|もの}→乗り物：01694_norimono⟧{酔|よ}い: seasickness / carsickness / motion sickness

WATCH OUT:
{酔|よ}い is a homophone of ⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧ (good) and ⟦{宵|よい}→宵：27202_yoi⟧ (early evening); the kanji or the context tells them apart.
